कुक्षः The belly.

—1 The belly (in general); जिह्मिताध्मातकुक्षिः (भुजगपतिः) Mk. 9. 12.
—2 The womb, the part of the belly containing the foetus; कुम्भीनस्याश्च

—3 The interior of anything; विभक्तात्मा विभुस्तासामेकः कुक्षिष्वनेकधा
 R. 10. 65 (where the word is used in sense 2 also.)
—4 A cavity in general.
—5 A cavern, cave;

—6 The sheath of a sword.
—7 N. of Bali.
—8 A bay, gulf.
